subject.title: fix(external): guard Cleanup orphan sweep against a concurrent same-scope Acquire's claim

question: Should external Cleanup retain routing state whenever an orphan claim is removed, accepting small stale routing residue to prevent a concurrently reacquired lease from becoming unroutable?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes persistent cleanup behavior: immediate routing deletion is unsafe during the documented Acquire ordering, while retention trades that safety for deferred residue cleanup.

options.title: Retain routing during orphan-claim cleanup
options.body: Accept the small stale-routing residue because preserving routing is necessary to avoid an availability failure for a concurrent same-scope reacquisition.

options.title: Require a separately designed routing GC path
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define a wider ownership fence or safe garbage-collection policy that can remove stale routing without racing Acquire.

recommendation.title: Retain routing during orphan-claim cleanup
recommendation.body: Accept the small stale-routing residue because preserving routing is necessary to avoid an availability failure for a concurrent same-scope reacquisition.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged adjacent cleanup work and the branch’s final documentation update indicate the strongest current connection to this provider-cleanup decision.
